markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set is Normal only, and all 5 similar cases agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal >99%, Benign <1% | Clear separation |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% / 10th percentile | Typical input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 4, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Concept model links it to lower invasive likelihood · Weak [F3]
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7, 8, 11) · ↓ invasive · Concept model links it to lower invasive likelihood · Validated [F4]
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 2, 9) · ↓ invasive · Top-scoring concept, but failed AI spot check (0/20) · Unreliable [F2]
- **Neoplastic-labelled nuclei** (region 10) · context · 91 of 306 nuclei there; 26% sample-wide · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007), so not shown to reflect the classifier; Normal lobules is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Region 10's neoplastic-labelled nuclei reflect real atypia the Normal call underweights.
- Calibration rests on a small test set (n=132, ECE 0.05, CI 0.03–0.18).

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 10:** Confirm whether the 91 neoplastic-labelled nuclei are atypical epithelium.
2. **Regions 0, 2, 9:** Verify normal lobular architecture directly; the concept score failed its spot check.
3. **Regions 4, 5, 6:** Confirm the glands show benign architecture.
